entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucius Coelius Antipater was a Roman jurist and historian. He is not to be confused with Coelius Sabinus, the Coelius of the Digest. He was a contemporary of C. Gracchus ; L. Crassus, the orator, was his pupil.
